A10Analogue

Slew Limiter

Portamento and simple envelopes

Limits how fast a voltage can change, turning a step into a ramp. Rising and falling edges have separate controls.

  • Times from about 1 ms to 10 s
  • Turns a gate into an attack-release envelope
  • Smooths random voltages and sequencer steps
